args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since deploying v2.3.1 to production (unhealthy in us-east, us-west, eu-west; error rate 0.18). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Monitoring to confirm recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified (`rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. On-call was paged.

4. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api healthy in all regions with error rate back down to 0.2%.
